title: Cat on the Keyboard
prompt: Your cat sat on the keyboard and every key got pressed twice: 'hheelllloo'. Undo the damage and return 'hello'.
hint: Slicing can skip characters: s[start:stop:step].

title: Pizza Party
prompt: Every pizza has 8 slices. Everyone eats slices_each slices. How many pizzas do you order? Leftovers are fine; hungry guests are not.
hint: Total slices, then round UP. -(-a // b) is a sneaky ceiling.

title: Roomba, Go Home
prompt: A robot vacuum follows moves like 'UDLR' (up, down, left, right). Return True if it ends up back on its charger.
hint: Ups cancel downs, lefts cancel rights. str.count() is your friend.

title: sPoNgEcAsE
prompt: Turn text into mocking SpongeBob case. Letters alternate lower, UPPER, lower… starting lowercase. Spaces and punctuation don't count toward the pattern.
hint: Keep a flag that flips only when you hit a letter (str.isalpha()).

title: Haunted House
prompt: Count how many times 'boo' appears in the noise coming from the attic. Ghosts don't care about capital letters.
hint: Lowercase it first, then str.count().

title: How Many Bars?
prompt: Turn a WiFi signal (in dBm, always negative) into bars: -50 or better is 4, -60 or better is 3, -70 or better is 2, -80 or better is 1. Worse than that: 0 bars, go outside.
hint: A chain of if/elif, checking the strongest signal first.

title: Talk Like a Pirate
prompt: Translate a lowercase sentence word by word: hello→ahoy, my→me, friend→matey, yes→aye, you→ye. Other words stay the same.
hint: Make a dict, then split(), look up each word with .get(word, word), and join().

title: Yahtzee!
prompt: You rolled five dice. Return True if they all show the same number.
hint: A set throws away duplicates.

title: Lazy Elevator
prompt: An elevator starts on floor 0 and visits the floors in stops, in order. How many floors did it travel in total?
hint: Track where you are now; add abs(next - current) each time.

title: X Marks the Spot
prompt: A pirate map says things like ['N3', 'E2', 'S1']. Start at [0, 0]. N adds to y, S subtracts, E adds to x, W subtracts. Return the treasure's [x, y].
hint: step[0] is the direction, int(step[1:]) is the distance (could be 2 digits!).

title: Bubble Wrap
prompt: A sheet of bubble wrap is a list of rows like 'oxo'. o is unpopped, x is popped. How many satisfying pops are left?
hint: Count the o's in each row and add them up.

title: No Repeats, DJ
prompt: The crowd boos if the same song plays twice in a row. Return True if the playlist never repeats a song back to back.
hint: Compare each song with the one right after it. zip(songs, songs[1:]) pairs neighbours.

title: Grow a Tree
prompt: Draw a tree n rows tall as a list of strings. Row i (from 0) has 2*i + 1 stars, centered with spaces on the left only. n = 3 gives ['  *', ' ***', '*****'].
hint: Row i needs n - 1 - i spaces in front. ' ' * k makes k spaces.

title: Vending Machine
prompt: Give change using as few coins as possible. Return [quarters, dimes, nickels, pennies].
hint: Use the biggest coin as much as you can: divmod(cents, 25) gives count and remainder.

title: The Bouncer
prompt: A password gets one point each for: 8+ characters, a digit, an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter. Return the score (0 to 4).
hint: any(c.isdigit() for c in pw) checks for a digit. True counts as 1 when you add.

title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
prompt: Two players throw 'rock', 'paper' or 'scissors'. Return 'a' or 'b' for the winner, or 'draw'.
hint: Write down what each throw beats in a dict: {'rock': 'scissors', …}.

title: Who Won?
prompt: A finished tic-tac-toe board is three strings like 'XOX'. Return 'X' or 'O' if someone has three in a row (row, column or diagonal), else None.
hint: Build a list of all 8 lines as strings, then check if 'XXX' or 'OOO' is in it.

title: Spy Note
prompt: A spy shifted every letter 3 places forward in the alphabet ('a' became 'd', 'z' became 'c'). Shift them back. Keep case; leave everything else alone.
hint: ord() and chr() turn letters into numbers and back. % 26 handles the wrap.

title: Hallway of Lightbulbs
prompt: n bulbs, all off. Person 1 flips every bulb, person 2 flips every 2nd, person 3 every 3rd… up to person n. How many bulbs are on at the end?
hint: Just simulate it with a list of booleans. (Then look at the answers. Notice anything?)

title: Birthday Twins
prompt: Birthdays look like 'MM-DD'. Return True if any two people in the room share one.
hint: If turning the list into a set makes it shorter, something repeated.

title: Leap Day Baby
prompt: Someone born on Feb 29 in year born only gets a real birthday in leap years. How many have they had by the end of year now? Leap years: divisible by 4, except centuries, unless divisible by 400.
hint: Loop over years born+1 to now and count the leap ones.

title: Snail in a Well
prompt: A snail climbs up meters each day and slides down meters each night. It escapes the moment it reaches the top. How many days to get out of a well this deep? (up > down)
hint: Careful: if it reaches the top during the day, it doesn't slide back.
